note: The Hollow's fighting numbers (H0, the move arena, approved by Matt October 27, 2026; docs/future/16-the-sea-cave.md, Fighting, The lantern, The bestiary). Loaded by tools/move-arena.html?course=hollow only until H3; nothing in the game reads it yet. camera: the walker camera's numbers below ground (as recipes/world/walker.json camera), higher and further back so the floor reads; fade: walls and pillars between the eye and the walker (or the locked target) fade to fillAlpha with a soft outline instead of the camera pulling in; lockFrame: while locked, the view aims frameShare of the way from you to the target and turns to keep both in view at turnPerS (a share a second), so the mouse still nudges it. lantern: fuel (a full lantern), burnPerS as it hangs and raisedBurnPerS while the right mouse holds it up, sipFuel what one hit costs (a sip), reachM how far its light reaches (raisedReachM held up, emberReachM snuffed), glintM how far past the light a thing still glints (lockable), ambient the chamber's own light (a share), raiseS how long the lantern takes to come up. lock: outOfReachS, how long a locked thing may stay out of the light before the lock drops. dot: the floor dot's range from the camera's tilt, farM at levelDeg (the camera's least tilt) and nearM at downDeg (its most), stepM how finely it walks the grid. swing: the staff's reach (m, from the walker's middle) and arc (degrees, centred ahead), the clips left click may play, each with the shares of its length where a hit lands; sideDeg and backDeg: a hit from more than this off a thing's front counts as on its side, or its back. foes: the stand-ins' steps (rest, notice, close in, wind-up, strike, recover), timed from doc 16's table: noticeM, closeMps, strikeM (how near before the wind-up), windS (the tell), strikeS, dashM (a lunge's reach), hitM (how near a strike must end to land), recoverS (the opening), hp (hits to break), frontDeg (an armored front), size (small or large, for Taproot). The watcher's callM: how far its call carries; turnDegPerS its slow turn. The motes keep out of the raised lantern's reach by keepOutM and dart in to nip.
